text.p: Brunswick Corp said Monday it completed the previously announced purchase of Igloo Holdings Inc for $152 million in cash.

When the deal was first announced in November, Brunswick said it would pay about $154 million for Igloo. The price was later adjusted, the company said. Igloo makes ice chests, beverage coolers and thermoelectric cooler/warmer products.
"Igloo expands the scope of our recreational product offerings and ties in perfectly with Brunswick's other active recreation products," Peter Larson, chairman, said in a statement.
Brunswick serves the outdoor and indoor recreation markets with fishing reels and rods, camping gear, bicycles, billiard tables, boats and bowling centers.

"In the past 12 months, we have invested nearly $500 million to acquire the American Camper and Remington camping equipment lines, Roadmaster bicycles, Boston Whaler offshore fishing boats and now, Igloo," Larson said.
